Name: Elliott's Piano Improved
Author: Mushroomyx
Description:
In the base game, the Piano in Elliott's cabin can be played by clicking on it. However you only have 4 notes at your disposal, thus it is more of a gimmick/easter egg rather than a full on feature. But not anymore, with Elliott's Piano Improved you can play full songs either freely or via MIDI. This Mod requires my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28551]Playable Piano Mod[/url] and is intended as an example, of how it's API can be utilized.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url] and of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28551]Playable Piano[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Right click one of the tiles of Elliott's Piano you usually can click on, to play one of the four notes. This will bring up the Playable Piano UI, where you can choose between Freeplay Mode, and MIDI Playback. In Freeplay Mode you can play the Piano by pressing keys on your keyboard. In MIDI Playback mode you can automatically play a MIDI File from the songs folder of Playable Piano. For more Information, please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28551]check out the Mod Page for Playable Piano[/url].

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer, if both players have the Playable Piano Mod installed
[*]Mostly works in split-screen, but the UI may be broken
[/list]
